context: Mei and Daichi watch Hikari and discuss her emerging personality.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ダイチ、ひかりの姿、見て、可愛いね。
lines.en: Daichi — look at how cute Hikari is right now.
lines.style: Soft, almost hushed opening. Gentle warmth threading through. Genuine delight without performance. A tender moment of shared noticing, voice held close.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ほんま、毎日、変わるなぁ。
lines.en: Really, she changes every single day.
lines.style: Light Kansai lilt on the opening. Warm amazement — not exclaiming, but the steadiness of someone continually surprised. Soft wonder underlying the regional cadence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: She's been smiling so much lately.
lines.style: Quiet observation, reflective. Warmth beneath the noticing — not commenting from outside but speaking from inside the joy. Gentle trailing into the realization.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: She laughs whenever she sees my face.
lines.style: Pride softened by tenderness — not boasting, but saying it like a small miracle. Kansai warmth in the delivery. A man still amazed that this is his life.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 人見知り、まだ、しないね。
lines.en: She's not shy around people anymore.
lines.style: Observant, marking the change without fanfare. Warm noticing. A slight lift at the end — the pleasure of recognizing her growing comfortable in the world.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai swing carrying gentle pride. The realization settling into his voice — not a problem to solve, but a gift to marvel at. Soft, genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: She really is our greatest treasure.
lines.style: Deeper register now. The word 'treasure' carries weight — philosophical, profound. Quiet intensity beneath the warmth. A man speaking from the center of his life.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Yeah, I'm happy every single day.
lines.style: Kansai affection in the cadence. Settling into truth rather than declaring it. Simple, deep. The voice of someone who knows exactly what matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お父さん、お母さん、見せたい。
lines.en: I want to show her to your parents.
lines.style: Gentle wish underneath. Reaching toward connection — wanting to share this with the people who matter. Soft, open vulnerability in the reach.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 来週、皆、集まる、楽しみや。
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to everyone gathering next week.
lines.style: Kansai brightness lifting the anticipation higher. Genuine excitement — not restless, but the warm eagerness of someone about to see his whole world in one room.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 皆で、一緒に、過ごす時間、大切。
lines.en: The time we spend together like this — all of us — that's what matters.
lines.style: Philosophical settling in. The voice of someone recognizing the shape of her own happiness. Tender, unhurried. A quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: これから、もっと、楽しいで。
lines.en: It's only going to get better from here.
lines.style: Kansai promise in the delivery. Opening up toward the future with genuine warmth — not wishful, but the conviction of someone building something real. Forward-leaning tenderness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本当ね。これからも、一緒に、歩こう。
lines.en: It really is. Let's keep walking together from here on.
lines.style: Meeting his promise with her own. Deep, settled warmth. Not romantic performance but intimate certainty — the voice of someone who has chosen this and chooses it again with each word.
